'''Torsten Ivan Lindqvist''' (2 December 1925 – 3 November 2002) was a Swedish [[Modern pentathlon|modern pentathlete]] who competed in the [[1952 Summer Olympics]]. He finished ninth individually and won a silver medal with the Swedish team.<ref name=sr/> At the world championships he won team gold medals in 1951 and 1953 and an individual bronze in 1951.<ref name=sok/>

After retiring from competitions Lindqvist became an internationally renowned nuclear physicist.<ref name=sok/>
